resources.string: Thresholds crossed, constellations completed, and identities the Castle considers permanent.
The Sanctum reveals one fragment at a time. It never exposes the full condition before discovery, and a completed record never reseals.
A flame kept for many returns begins to remember the hand that lit it.
Consistency leaves a different mark than intensity. The Castle has begun to recognize your return.
A quiet flame answers duration before it answers devotion.
Returning matters more than one long vigil.
Time and return must become the same habit.
Some doors are written in the margins rather than printed on the page.
Enough passages have been preserved that your annotations now form a second text beside the books themselves.
The margin begins as an echo.
A second text forms only when preserved passages become numerous.
The gate appears when reading and marginalia become inseparable.
Finished volumes gather weight. Eventually the shelf becomes a foundation.
Your completed books and first Path threshold now reinforce one another. The archive is becoming a place, not a list.
Finished books weigh more than unfinished possibility.
A Path threshold changes what the shelf can bear.
Completion and advancement must reinforce the same foundation.
There is a point when time spent reading stops feeling counted.
Fifty hours have passed inside books. The Castle records the duration, but the deeper change cannot be measured in minutes.
Long attention changes the room before it changes the title.
Remain long enough that counted time stops being the point.
Several marks must awaken before they begin to answer one another.
Your earned sigils are no longer isolated milestones. Together they form the first readable pattern in the Veil.
One sigil is a mark. Several begin to answer one another.
The pattern needs more than isolated milestones.
When enough marks resonate, the hidden surface becomes legible.
The deepest chamber does not open to a single achievement.
A mature Path and a complete core sigil constellation have revealed a chamber that the early Castle could not name.
The deepest door ignores solitary achievements.
Mature Path identity must meet a nearly complete constellation.
Only convergence reveals the chamber that early ranks cannot name.
The Castle recognizes a complete Path and a full core constellation. A hidden record has surfaced below.
Reach the final Path rank and awaken all five core sigils. The remaining door has no visible handle.
SOVEREIGN RECORD · THE STAR BETWEEN SHELVES
There was never a final shelf. Only another threshold hidden behind the act of returning.
A permanent inscription is present here, but its condition has not yet been satisfied.
